text:
zoe: Customer on PRO plan -> rerank endpoint returning 'embedding dim mismatch' when sending mixed batch. Customer says single-item requests succeed. request_id: 01H7ZKQW2YZ4A5B6

raj: Can you paste the exact curl payload and request id? client sdk / language?

zoe: Here's the curl they sent (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rerank-1",
    "queries": [
      {"id": "q1", "embedding": [0.01, 0.02, ..., 0.03] },
      {"id": "q2", "embedding": [0.01, 0.02, ..., 0.03] },
      {"id": "q3", "embedding": [0.01, 0.02, ..., 0.03] },
      {"id": "q4", "embedding": [0.01, 0.02, ..., 0.03] }
    ],
    "candidates": [ ... ]
  }'
```

zoe: Customer says q1-q3 are 1536-length vectors, q4 was produced by an external service and is 1024-length. Server returns 400: "embedding vector length 1024 does not match model dimension 1536". Happens only when q4 included in batch.

marta: Likely a client-side shape mix (np.array vs list) or an SDK that squashes dims for single items. Also double-check they aren't accidentally sending nested arrays like [[...]] for some items.

raj: Can you paste the platform log snippet for request 01H7ZKQW2YZ4A5B6? We need the internal error trace and the model config used.

zoe: From api-logs (sanitized):

```
ERROR req=01H7ZKQW2YZ4A5B6 handler=rerank handler_version=2.1.0 msg="embedding dimension mismatch" expected_dim=1536 saw_dim=1024
stack: validate_embeddings -> pack_batch -> model_forward
``` 

zoe: Also customer provided client-side code: they build a list of embeddings by extending from two sources; one uses list(map(float, arr)), the other uses arr.astype(np.float32).tolist(). Might be a dtype->serialization step dropping trailing zeros? not sure.

marta: Quick repro idea: send a mixed batch with one short vector. If we can repro we can fail fast and tie to validation layer. raj, can you run a quick curl with an explicit short vector to confirm 400?

raj: Yep doing now. Repro curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-1","queries":[{"id":"a","embedding":[0.0,0.0,0.0]}, {"id":"b","embedding":[0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0, ... truncated for brevity]}], "candidates":[] }'
```

raj: Response: 400, body: {"error":"embedding vector length 3 does not match model dimension 1536"}

sre-bot: To collect a debug bundle run: /debug-bundle --request 01H7ZKQW2YZ4A5B6 --include api-logs,ingest-traces,kvcache --expires 72h

zoe: I triggered the debug-bundle (id dbg-2026-04-12-7ZKQ). Attached to the Zendesk ticket. Customer has agreed to resend a sanitized payload if we need it.

marta: Next steps:
- raj to confirm validation code path and whether we normalize shapes before batching
- raj to check telemetry for similar reqs in last 24h
- ask customer to re-send a single failing payload (sanitized) and their client versions

raj: I'll take it. Initial hypothesis: validation occurs after we coerce dtypes; mixing lists and numpy might produce jagged arrays that our packer doesn't detect until batch pack. I'll run unit repro and propose a fix (validate per-item length at API entry).

clara: FYI flagged for priority review. If we can reproduce quickly mark P1.

zoe: I'll update the ticket with the debug-bundle id and ask customer to try the suggested change (ensure all embeddings are the same length/type). Will loop back with raj's findings.

raj: Quick note: if customer used gzip transfer or an intermediary that compresses individual fields we should also check content-encoding mismatch; observed in a different issue previously.

marta: Good point. Also add a logging improvement: include per-item dims in the validation error to surface which index is bad.

zoe: Thanks team — will keep the thread updated. Closing for now until repro or customer follow-up.
